messages:
Lina (UX): morning — quick sketch: instead of Models/Datasets/Endpoints as separate top items, what if we surface a single 'Assets' group with collapsible sub-items? reduces visual noise and mirrors how customers navigate.
Mike R (Frontend): curious how that affects deep links. external docs currently link to /console/models/:slug. collapsing in the UI is fine but links must be stable.
Lina (UX): agreed — idea: keep existing public URL surface but canonicalize nav to /console/assets/:kind/:id for new links. we can support both for a while via redirects.
Sam (Eng): implementation constraints: we have client-side route handling + server edge redirects. we should avoid changing hash-only routes. prefer full path for subviews like /metrics or /settings so it can be crawled/bookmarked.
Priya (A11y): accessibility: whenever we programmatically change routes, announce the new page title via an ARIA live region and move focus to the page h1. collapsing nav groups must not trap keyboard users. also ensure group toggles are buttons with aria-expanded.
Jasper (Platform): note for private installs: some customers mount the console under /customer-x/console. any redirects must be basePath-aware. we'll expose a BASE_PATH env var to the redirect middleware.
Mike R (Frontend): routing contract proposal (draft):
```
/console/assets/:kind/:id               -> overview
/console/assets/:kind/:id/metrics      -> metrics view
/console/assets/:kind/:id/config       -> config view
```
Also support legacy: /console/models/:id -> redirect to /console/assets/models/:id (preserve querystring).
Sam (Eng): suggestion: use a 307 for the first 30 days, then flip to 308 when we mark permanent. add a redirect log so we can measure hits to legacy paths.
Lina (UX): breadcrumbs should show humanized segments: Console > Assets > Endpoints > my-endpoint — even if URL has numeric id. UX rule: breadcrumb labels come from resource displayName, not slug.
Mike R (Frontend): edgecase: renaming resource changes displayName. permalink must not break. use stable id in URL: /.../endpoints/12345-my-fancy-endpoint but routing should match only on prefix id. if slug differs, we can client-redirect to canonical but avoid server redirect churn.
Priya (A11y): extra a11y nit: when we client-redirect because slug mismatch, ensure we call focus() on skip-to-main target after nav and that screen reader hears the live region update.
Jasper (Platform): telemetry plan: emit event: navigation.click(category, item, source="left-nav"), route.redirected(old, new, reason). that'll help plan TTL for redirects.
Sam (Eng): will add a small middleware config file mapping legacy -> canonical and a feature flag to toggle 308 behavior. PR will include tests for querystring preservation.
Mike R (Frontend): UX question: do we want to collapse some sections by default (e.g., if user has no datasets, hide that row) or keep consistent ordering? preference: keep order stable and show empty state badges rather than hiding items. helps muscle memory.
Lina (UX): agree. show placeholders with a "Create" CTA. also add a tooltip on hover that explains what each asset type contains.
Jasper (Platform): private deployment note: some customers route traffic via API gateway that strips path params. we'll include a health-check endpoint for redirects and a diagnostic page listing current redirect mappings for ops.
Sam (Eng): draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/634 (includes redirect middleware, basePath handling, and test matrix). staging dry-run scheduled.
nav-bot: staging deploy queued: 2025-01-03T08:30Z (contains redirect table + client route updates).
Priya (A11y): can we add a quick keyboard navigation test in the e2e suite? tab order, aria-expanded, and screen reader announce check. happy to help write assertions.
Mike R (Frontend): yes I'll slot that in. also adding unit test for breadcrumb label priority (displayName > slug > id).
Lina (UX): migration comms: add an in-app banner on old pages saying "nav update coming — links will continue to work." link to docs. marketing wants copy by EOD.
Jasper (Platform): I'll prepare redirect metrics and a small rollback plan if customers report broken links.
Lina (UX): thanks all — will follow up with a tiny mock of the collapsed Assets group and tooltip copy. meeting if folks want to see flow. :wave:
Sam (Eng): opening PR now, tagging @Mike R and @Priya for review.
Mike R (Frontend): on it. :thumbsup:
